name: AI4MEME
tagline: Turn your photos into short meme videos using published scene templates.
description:
AI4MEME is a credit-priced image-to-video studio that turns uploaded photos into short meme videos using published scene templates. Instead of starting with an open-ended text prompt or a full editing timeline, a user chooses a scene and supplies the photos it requires. Each template shows the photo count, duration, aspect ratio and credit cost before generation, so the requirements are visible before a job starts.

The workflow is designed for people making short personal meme clips from photos of consenting adults. Creations are private by default, and the service does not provide a public gallery or feed. Failed generation jobs refund credits. The studio is accessed through a web browser with Google sign-in; it is not presented as a public API or an autonomous software agent.

Users should check the selected template and current pricing before generating. It is a scene-template video tool, not a guarantee of identical body shape or unrestricted use of somebody else's likeness.
